reviewNotes: Reviewed all 100 exported speech keys against all 25 source cards in data/pages47-49-forms.json. Object を rendered お; no topic は or directional へ in these keys. Preserved lexical 刃 は, はさき, はばひろ, はも and 家庭で幅広く かていではばひろく. Removed English slash translations from generation input, retaining exact original lookup keys. Corrected duplicate むきもの in annotation output, source 飾り切 to かざりぎり and 引き切り to ひきぎり. Checked knife names and explicit readings against source. Converted バラン to ばらん; terminal punctuation supplied. Display labels unchanged. No listening or pitch accent verification. Recovered previously filtered bilingual labels and checked every knife-name question against source furigana, including けんむき, ばらんきり, ふぐでば and ふぐひき; removed annotation duplication in inputs.
